entities.name: Jean Baptist, Comte d'Arco
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Generalfeldmarschall Jean Baptist, Comte d'Arco was a German military officer, diplomat nobleman who served in the Bavarian Army and the Imperial Army during the Great Turkish War and the War of the Spanish Succession.
